name: Onboarding flow completes all 5 steps and builds the user footprint
description: A logged-in user without activities steps through all 5 onboarding screens (travel, home energy, food, flights, waste) and submits, then lands on the dashboard with their footprint calculated.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth/login and sign in with email 'demo@offset.io' and password 'Password123!'
Verify step 1 of 5 is visible with the heading 'How do you get around?' and the progress bar is shown
Click the 'Yes, I drive' button to confirm having a vehicle
Click the 'Next' button to advance to step 2
Verify step 2 heading 'How much power does your home use?' is shown
Click the 'Next' button to advance to step 3
Verify step 3 heading 'What do you usually eat?' is shown
Click the 'Next' button to advance to step 4
Verify step 4 heading 'How much do you fly?' is shown
Click the 'Next' button to advance to step 5
Verify step 5 heading 'How much do you throw away?' is shown
Click the 'See my footprint →' button to submit the onboarding form
Verify the page navigates to /dashboard and shows the 'Footprint Overview' header band with a CO₂e figure
